title: Pure Cyberse
summary: Pure Cyberse focuses on Yusaku Fujiki's 'Cyberse' named multi-summoning toolkit (Cyberse Magician, Cyberse Quantum Dragon, Cyberse Clock Dragon, Cyberse Enchanter, Cyberse Witch, and Cyberse Wicckid). Using Lady Debug, Cyberse Gadget, and Cynet Mining to climb into Cyberse Witch and Cyberse Wicckid, the deck simultaneously fields Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Cyberse bosses to create a total targeting and attack lock.

allow.Lady Debug: Searches any Level 3 or lower Cyberse monster (like Cyberse Synchron or Cyberse Converter) on Normal or Special Summon.
allow.Clock Wyvern: Essential Fusion Material for Cyberse Clock Dragon that summons a Clock Token on Normal/Special Summon to make Cyberse Witch or Wicckid.
allow.Backup Secretary: Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Cyberse monster.
allow.Clock Spartoi: Link-2 Cyberse that searches Cynet Fusion on Link Summon.
allow.Link Disciple: Link-1 Cyberse that tributes a co-linked monster to draw 1 and fix your hand while triggering Cyberse Witch or Wicckid.
allow.Link Devotee: Link-1 Cyberse that summons 2 Link Tokens when tributed by Link Disciple to climb into Cyberse Witch and Wicckid.
allow.Update Jammer: Link-2 Cyberse that allows an Extra Deck monster to attack twice.

main: Cyberse Magician
Level 7 Cyberse Ritual boss that halves all damage you take and prevents the opponent from targeting or attacking any other monster while you control a Link Monster.
Cyberse Gadget
Revives a Level 2 or lower monster from the GY on Normal Summon and generates a Gadget Token when sent from the field to the GY.
Cyberse Synchron
Level 1 Cyberse Tuner searched by Cyberse Wicckid that doubles the Level of a Level 4 or lower monster to make Level 7 Cyberse Quantum Dragon.
Cyberse White Hat
Special Summons itself if you control 2+ monsters of the same Type and weakens all opposing monsters by 1000 ATK when used as Link Material.
Cyberse Converter
Special Summons itself if all monsters you control are Cyberse.
Lady Debug
One-card starter that searches Cyberse Synchron, Cyberse Converter, or Backup Secretary.
Clock Wyvern
Summons a Clock Token to immediately Link Summon Cyberse Witch or Cyberse Wicckid, and serves as the named Fusion Material for Cyberse Clock Dragon.
Backup Secretary
Free Level 3 Cyberse extender from hand.
Cynet Mining
Sends 1 card from hand to GY to search any Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster from the Deck.
Cynet Ritual
Ritual Spell searched by Cyberse Witch that summons Cyberse Magician and banishes from GY to generate 2 Cynet Tokens.
Cynet Fusion
Fusion Spell searched by Clock Spartoi that summons Cyberse Clock Dragon using Link Monsters from the GY if you have no Extra Monster Zone monster.
Cynet Optimization
Continuous Spell that grants an extra Normal Summon of a Cyberse monster and prevents opponent activations when your Code Talker/Cyberse attacks.
Cynet Conflict
Counter Trap that negates any Spell/Trap or monster effect and banishes it.
extra: Fusion boss that mills cards equal to the Link Rating used, gains 1000 ATK per milled card, and protects other monsters when you control a Link Monster.
Level 7 Synchro boss that bounces any monster it battles at the start of the Damage Step and pairs with Cyberse Magician for a complete soft-lock.
Rank 3 Xyz that detaches 1 material to add any 'Cynet' Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand.
Link-3 monster that steals control of an opponent's monster or negates its effects.
Link-2 that banishes a Spell from GY when a monster is summoned to its arrow to search both Cyberse Magician AND Cynet Ritual simultaneously, then revives a Level 4 or lower Cyberse.
Link-2 that cannot be destroyed by battle/effects and banishes a Cyberse from GY when a monster is summoned to its arrow to search Cyberse Synchron.
Link-2 Cyberse that searches Cynet Fusion on Link Summon.
Link-1 Cyberse starter that triggers Cyberse Witch and Cyberse Wicckid.
Link-1 Cyberse that generates 2 Tokens when Tributed by Link Disciple.
Link-2 extender that enables double attacks.
